title: Darwin, Northern Territory — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Darwin, Northern Territory: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Darwin is a city in Northern Territory with a population of 148,564. Australia’s tropical northern capital with a multicultural vibe, outdoor markets, and Litchfield National Park. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
